results.title: Trump administration moves ahead with efforts to fire Federal Reserve governor Lisa Cook
results.description: The Trump administration is moving ahead with its efforts to fire Federal Reserve governor Lisa Cook, two months after the Supreme Court allowed her to retain her job while she fights the president’s effort to terminate her over mortgage fraud allegations that she has denied.
